This file is for doing data import.

## Import 2 CSV
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Import our first dataset.

```{r}
litters_df = 
  read.csv(file = "data/FAS_litters.csv", skip = 0)

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```

Import your second dataset.

```{r}
pups_df = 
  read.csv(file = "data/FAS_pups.csv", skip = 3) #skip first 3 rows

pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df) #a package::a function inside the package
```

## Look at the data

```{r}
litters_df
pups_df
```

Head or tail

```{r}
head(litters_df, 20)
tail(pups_df, 5)
```

skimming??

```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df) #a package::a function inside the package
```
